name: icloud-mail
description: Read, organize, draft, and send iCloud Mail locally, with optional self-hosted read-only remote access.

interface.longDescription: iCloud Mail connects Codex directly to Apple's TLS IMAP and SMTP services. A temporary local setup page validates an app-specific password and saves it in macOS Keychain. Search, read, organize, draft, and send mail on demand without creating a local mailbox copy or email index. Requested mail returned to Codex enters the conversation. An optional self-hosted read-only HTTPS server supports separate user accounts on always-on infrastructure. No hosted endpoint is included; remote use requires operator-approved hosting and OAuth configuration.
defaultPrompt: Find recent iCloud email and draft a reply.
